meta.build_type: release (cargo --release: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort)

extension.note: no git repository; source hash = sha256 over engines/duckdb/{Cargo.toml,Cargo.lock,src/*.rs}

pinning.note: logical CPUs 0-15 = 8 P-cores x 2 SMT; 16-31 = E-cores

load_before.note: load average is recorded for information only; the gate is instantaneous CPU and GPU use

sql_in_query.naive: SELECT k, SUM(EXP(s/0.1)*v)/SUM(EXP(s/0.1)) FROM (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000) b GROUP BY k
sql_in_query.maxshift_cte: WITH b AS (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000), mx AS (SELECT k, MAX(s) AS m FROM b GROUP BY k) SELECT b.k, SUM(EXP((b.s-mx.m)/0.1)*b.v)/SUM(EXP((b.s-mx.m)/0.1)) FROM b JOIN mx ON b.k = mx.k GROUP BY b.k
sql_in_query.maxshift_window: SELECT k, SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)*v)/SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)) FROM (SELECT k, v, s, MAX(s) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS m FROM (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000) b) w GROUP BY k
sql_in_query.clamp: SELECT k, SUM(CASE WHEN (s-m)/0.1 < -700 THEN 0 ELSE EXP((s-m)/0.1) END*v)/SUM(CASE WHEN (s-m)/0.1 < -700 THEN 0 ELSE EXP((s-m)/0.1) END) FROM (SELECT k, v, s, MAX(s) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS m FROM (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000) b) w GROUP BY k
sql_in_query.softavg: SELECT k, softavg(v, s, 0.1) FROM (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000) b GROUP BY k
sql_in_query.softavg_p2: SELECT k, softavg(v, s, 0.1) FROM (SELECT facet AS k, value AS v, array_inner_product(emb, ?::FLOAT[384])::DOUBLE AS s FROM d.movies WHERE filter_num >= 2000) b GROUP BY k

sql_precomputed.naive: SELECT k, SUM(EXP(s/0.1)*v)/SUM(EXP(s/0.1)) FROM (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc) b GROUP BY k
sql_precomputed.maxshift_cte: WITH b AS (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc), mx AS (SELECT k, MAX(s) AS m FROM b GROUP BY k) SELECT b.k, SUM(EXP((b.s-mx.m)/0.1)*b.v)/SUM(EXP((b.s-mx.m)/0.1)) FROM b JOIN mx ON b.k = mx.k GROUP BY b.k
sql_precomputed.maxshift_window: SELECT k, SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)*v)/SUM(EXP((s-m)/0.1)) FROM (SELECT k, v, s, MAX(s) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS m FROM (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc) b) w GROUP BY k
sql_precomputed.clamp: SELECT k, SUM(CASE WHEN (s-m)/0.1 < -700 THEN 0 ELSE EXP((s-m)/0.1) END*v)/SUM(CASE WHEN (s-m)/0.1 < -700 THEN 0 ELSE EXP((s-m)/0.1) END) FROM (SELECT k, v, s, MAX(s) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS m FROM (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc) b) w GROUP BY k
sql_precomputed.softavg: SELECT k, softavg(v, s, 0.1) FROM (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc) b GROUP BY k
sql_precomputed.softavg_p2: SELECT k, softavg(v, s, 0.1) FROM (SELECT k, v, s FROM sc) b GROUP BY k
